entities.summary: Corpse Husband, commonly abbreviated as Corpse and stylized in all caps, is an American retired YouTuber and musician. Corpse is best known for his music and "faceless" work on YouTube. He is mostly known for his horror story narration and Among Us content. He also gained notable recognition for his deep low-pitched voice.
